newsitem.title: USA: Air Express increases stake in Spanish unit.
newsitem.headline: Air Express increases stake in Spanish unit.

text.p: Air Express International Inc on Friday said it has increased from 20 percent to 48 percent its equity position in AEI Iberfreight, its long-time Spanish agent.
Terms of the deal were not disclosed. The company said it plans eventually to acquire 100 percent ownership of AEI Iberfreight.
Air Express said the move is part of a long-term plan to increase its ownership stake in its agents. Friday's action was the fourth such move in the past two years.
Air Express is a worldwide provider of freight transportation and related logistics services. It has 875 outlets in 135 countries.
AEI Iberfreight had 1996 revenues of $40 million with operations in nine cities, including the Canary Islands, Air Express said. The Spanish unit has 170 employees.
